title: One-Pot Gateway to Quinazoline-Thiohydantoin Fused Scaffolds and Discovery of Their Antileukemic Activity.
authors: Kersting, Lena; Zippel, Christoph; Herrmann, Lars; Elbadawi, Mohamed; Seo, Ean-Jeong; Heckmann, Felix; Saeed, Mohamed E M; Gaube, Angelika; Tailor, Dhanir; Dheeraj, Arpit; Malhotra, Sanjay V; Muehlich, Susanne; Efferth, Thomas; Tsogoeva, Svetlana B
one_liner_zh: 该文为有机合成与抗白血病药物发现研究，涉及小分子对接但无蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: In drug discovery, fusing bioactive heterocyclic frameworks leads to new analogs with improved properties. Quinazoline and thiohydantoin are prominent heterocycles, recognized for their diverse pharmacological profiles. Although quinazolines fused with various heterocycles are present in numerous clinical drugs, quinazoline-thiohydantoin fused frameworks, along with their synthetic approaches, remain unreported. Here, we introduce a transition metal-free, one-pot approach that enables the efficient and high-yielding synthesis (up to 92% yield) of this previously unexplored class of heterocyclic compounds. A streamlined three-step domino reaction, enabling the formation of three C-N bonds in a single operation, followed by dehydrogenation step, results in the desired quinazoline-thiohydantoin fused scaffolds, which exhibit potent and selective cytotoxicity against multidrug-resistant P-glycoprotein-overexpressing CEM/ADR5000 leukemia cells. The compounds, achieving IC(50) values as low as 0.13 +/- 0.02 muM, are over 290-fold more active in vitro than the clinical standard doxorubicin (IC(50) = 38.17 +/- 13.32 muM). Screening of 474 kinases, in silico docking (binding energy: -7.38 +/- 0.02 kcal/mol; pKi: 3.9 +/- 0.12 muM), and dose-kinetic assays identified MAPK14 (p38alpha) as a primary target (IC(50) = 131 nM), consistent with its role in oncogenic stress signaling. Additionally, these compounds reduce nuclear localization of myocardin-related transcription factor A (MRTF-A), a key driver of tumor resistance. This new study lays the groundwork for developing quinazoline-thiohydantoin-based drugs that can overcome multidrug-resistance mechanisms.
abstract_zh: 在药物发现中，融合生物活性杂环框架可产生具有改进性质的新类似物。喹唑啉和硫代乙内酰脲是突出的杂环化合物，以其多样的药理学特征而闻名。尽管与多种杂环融合的喹唑啉存在于众多临床药物中，但喹唑啉-硫代乙内酰脲融合框架及其合成方法尚未见报道。在此，我们介绍一种无过渡金属、一锅法的方法，能够高效、高产率（最高达92%产率）地合成这类此前未探索的杂环化合物。一个简化的三步级联反应，在单次操作中形成三个C-N键，随后进行脱氢步骤，得到所需的喹唑啉-硫代乙内酰脲融合骨架，这些化合物对多药耐药P-糖蛋白过表达的CEM/ADR5000白血病细胞表现出强效且选择性的细胞毒性。这些化合物的IC(50)值低至0.13 ± 0.02 μM，在体外活性比临床标准药物多柔比星（IC(50) = 38.17 ± 13.32 μM）高出超过290倍。通过对474种激酶的筛选、计算机模拟对接（结合能：-7.38 ± 0.02 kcal/mol；pKi：3.9 ± 0.12 μM）以及剂量-动力学分析，确定MAPK14（p38alpha）为主要靶点（IC(50) = 131 nM），这与其在致癌应激信号传导中的作用一致。此外，这些化合物减少了心肌相关转录因子A（MRTF-A）的核定位，而MRTF-A是肿瘤耐药的关键驱动因素。这项新研究为开发能够克服多药耐药机制的基于喹唑啉-硫代乙内酰脲的药物奠定了基础。
